blocks.text: Alkanes ki substitution reactions roshni ki energy ki presence (maujood hona) mein hoti hain, aur in mein bohat reactive free radicals bante hain. Is ki aik misal halogenation hai, jis mein alkane ka aik hydrogen atom halogen atom se badal jata hai. Alkanes dhoop ya UV roshni mein chlorine aur bromine se react karte hain aur hydrogen atoms aik ke baad aik (successively) halogens se badalte jate hain. Halogenation kitni hogi, yeh is par depend karta hai ke halogen kitna istemal hua. Fluorine ke saath alkanes ki reaction bohat tez aur violent (khatarnak) hoti hai aur carbon, fluorinated alkanes aur hydrofluoric acid ka mixture banta hai. Iodine seedha substitute nahi karti kyunke reaction bohat slow (sust) aur reversible (ulti taraf bhi chalne wali) hai. Halogens ki reactivity ki tarteeb yeh hai:
Halogenation mein yeh teen steps hote hain.
i) Initiation step (shuru ka step): halogens ke saath alkanes ke free radical substitution ka pehla step. Is mein UV roshni ki energy se halogen-halogen bond toot-ta hai.

blocks.alt: Cl-Cl: bond se har Cl ki taraf ek fish-hook teer, hv wala teer, result (nateeja) Cl. + Cl.
blocks.caption: Initiation step (qadam): UV roshni mein chlorine ki homolysis (kitab ke page 253 par chhape diagram jaisi original drawing).

blocks.text: ii) Propagation step (aage barhne ka step): doosra step, jis mein pehle bane radicals alkane molecule par attack (hamla) karte hain aur zyada free radicals banate hain.

blocks.alt: Displayed formulae mein do equations. CH4 (ek C-H bond par do fish-hook teer) + Cl. se methyl radical (teen H aur dot (nuqta) wala C) + H-Cl. Methyl radical + Cl-Cl (bond par do fish-hook teer) se CH3Cl + Cl.
blocks.caption: Propagation step (kitab ke page 253 par chhape diagram jaisi original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Initiation mein roshni Cl–Cl bond ko barabar torti hai (har Cl ko aik electron). Propagation mein Cl• methane se aik H cheen kar HCl aur methyl radical (CH₃•) banata hai; phir CH₃• Cl₂ se aik Cl le kar CH₃Cl aur naya Cl• banata hai. Naya Cl• phir yahi kaam karta hai, is tarah chain chalti rehti hai.

iii) Termination step (khatam karne ka step): aakhri step, jis mein do free radicals aapas mein mil kar product banate hain. Termination kai tarah se ho sakti hai. Chlorine radical aur alkyl radical mil kar chloroalkane bana sakte hain, ya do chlorine radicals mil kar chlorine molecule bana sakte hain. Aik aur tareeqa yeh hai ke do alkyl radicals jur jayen aur dugne carbon atoms wala alkane ban jaye. Aisa kam hota hai aur yeh alkane sirf traces (bohat thori miqdar) mein banta hai, magar is ka banna proof (saboot) hai ke reaction free radical mechanism se hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Termination ke teen equations: i) methyl radical + Cl. se CH3Cl; ii) methyl radical + methyl radical se ethane H3C-CH3; iii) Cl. + Cl. se Cl-Cl.
blocks.caption: Termination step: i) se iii) (kitab ke page 254 par chhape diagram jaisi original drawing).

blocks.text: Step (ii), yani propagation, baar baar hone se halogen wale products (chloroalkanes) ka mixture milta hai. Shuru mein reaction mixture mein chlorine gas jitni zyada hogi, bane hue chloroalkane molecules mein chlorine atoms utne hi zyada honge.
Trichloromethane ko chloroform aur tetrachloromethane ko carbon tetrachloride bhi kehte hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information!
blocks.text: Haloalkanes anaesthetic hain, yani be-hosh kar dete hain. Jitne zyada halogen atoms, utni zyada be-hosh karne ki strength (taaqat). Yeh toxic (zehreele) hain, is liye lab mein solvents ke taur par in ke istemal par sakht nazar rakhi jati hai.

blocks.alt: CH3Cl (chloromethane) se CH2Cl2 (dichloromethane), phir CHCl3 (trichloromethane), phir CCl4 (tetrachloromethane); har teer par Cl. aur har step ke oopar red curved (mura hua) teer 'Further substitution with Cl. radical'.
blocks.caption: Chloromethane se tetrachloromethane tak step by step substitution (kitab ke page 254 par chhape diagram jaisi original drawing).
Methane ki chlorination
rows: CH₄ + Cl• → CH₃• + HCl; CH₃• + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl•
Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂; CH₃• + Cl• → CH₃Cl; CH₃• + CH₃• → CH₃CH₃ (thori miqdar)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Quick Check 11.3 (c) mein ‘halogenation of alkenes’ likha hai. Termination step jo is topic mein parha, woh alkanes ki free radical halogenation ka hai, is liye sawal alkanes ke bare mein samjhein.

blocks.prompt: Halogenation mein termination step kaise hota hai (Quick Check 11.3c)?
blocks.explanation: Jab do free radicals aapas mein milte hain to naya radical nahi banta aur chain ruk jati hai: Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂, CH₃• + Cl• → CH₃Cl, ya CH₃• + CH₃• → CH₃–CH₃ (thori miqdar).

blocks.prompt: Ethane ki free radical chlorination ke products batayein, aur woh conditions (halaat) batayein jin mein halogenoalkanes ka mixture milta hai (Quick Check 11.3d, e).
blocks.explanation: UV roshni mein chlorine ke saath ethane pehle chloroethane deta hai, phir aur substitution se dichloroethanes (1,1- aur 1,2-), trichloroethanes aur aage hexachloroethane tak, saath HCl bhi; do ethyl radicals ke milne se butane thori amount mein banti hai. Mixture tab milta hai jab roshni mein chlorine zyada ho ya reaction chalne di jaye, kyunke har chloroalkane phir se substitute ho sakta hai.

items: UV roshni mein free radicals se halogenation; reactivity F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂ (iodine seedha substitute nahi karti).
Initiation (Cl₂ → 2Cl•), propagation (CH₄ + Cl• → CH₃• + HCl; CH₃• + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl•), termination (radicals mil jate hain); products CH₃Cl, CH₂Cl₂, CHCl₃, CCl₄.
